prompt: First-person point of view. Two hands in dark suit sleeves rest on an empty dark wooden desk in a dim presidential office at night, rain streaking the window behind. A single old beige CRT computer monitor stands on the desk; its dark screen suddenly switches on and glows bright cold blue-white, the blue light spreading over the hands and the desk. Desk lamp off, pen holder. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, film grain.
